audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names a single Riven ability — everything is "her Q chain", "W-stun", "E shield", "three-Q knockup".
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/riven.json: P Runic Blade, Q Broken Wings, W Ki Burst, E Valor, R Blade of the Exile. The full layer already names Ki Burst, so the two layers read like different documents.
audit.corrected: Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor, Runic Blade, Blade of the Exile.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] and whys[3] both build the levels 4-5 power spike on "Riven's Q cooldown drops" / "Riven's tighter Q cooldown".
audit.why: Broken Wings is a flat 13 seconds at every rank — ranking it changes damage, not availability. The abilities that actually get shorter across levels 4-5 are Ki Burst (11/10/9/8/7s) and Valor (10/9/8/7/6s). The stated reason for her spike is the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Broken Wings is 13s at every rank; the 4-5 spike is Ki Burst reaching 9s and Valor reaching 8s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo's Q is written as "Blinding Shot" in spikes[3], wants.you[0], wants.foe[0], early, mid, whys[0] and whys[2].
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json gives slot Q as "Blinding Dart".

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and whys[6] call the first item "Liandry's Angueur".
audit.why: No such item. The full layer's Itemization line for this same matchup says Liandry's Torment.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.breakdown.late says "anti-heal stays core" and the Itemization report line says "his healing fights your pattern".
audit.why: Riven's kit has no healing at all — champ-data/_kits/riven.json carries no heal flag on any of the five slots. Whatever sustain she shows comes from Death's Dance or omnivamp on items, which is a late and conditional reason to buy Grievous Wounds, not a core one. Telling a Teemo to rush Oblivion Orb here costs him the Nashor's timing that actually wins the lane.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal is optional against Riven and only becomes relevant once she has a Death's Dance.

audit.whatIsWrong: Runic Blade is never mentioned anywhere, so the blind is presented as only denying auto damage.
audit.why: Riven's abilities charge Runic Blade and her basic attacks spend the charges. Blinding Dart makes those attacks miss, which means the charges she paid three ability casts to bank go nowhere. Blinding at the right moment costs her the passive damage as well as the autos — a meaningfully bigger swing than the entry currently claims.
audit.corrected: A blinded auto still expends nothing — the Runic Blade charges she stacked go to waste with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riven's ultimate is never described in the content layer, and dontsFull[1] ("Fight her R burst raw") carries a description about a different ability entirely.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile grants bonus AD and bonus range for its duration, then Wind Slash as a one-off ranged projectile. The range component is the part that matters to a kiting Teemo: the spacing that was safe all lane stops being safe the moment she ults, before any damage number changes.
audit.corrected: Blade of the Exile extends her attack and ability range — your lane kiting distance is wrong the second it comes on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is described as "a cooldown dance" without a single cooldown number on either side.
audit.why: Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, Broken Wings flat 13s, against Blinding Dart's flat 7s. Blinding Dart is up roughly one and a half times per Ki Burst early and only marginally more often by rank 5 — which is exactly why this lane sits at 49.6% rather than being a free win like the other melee matchups.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 against your flat 7s Q; that gap shrinks to 7 vs 7 by rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[0].why says "AA-poke + E poison wins almost every melee level 1" while the same stage is rated Riven 7/10 and the content layer says Riven owns level 1.
audit.why: Direct self-contradiction inside one stage. The content layer's reason is the correct one: Broken Wings weaves autos between casts faster than one blind can answer.
audit.corrected: Level 1 is hers — the Q-auto weave outpaces a single blind window.

edits.before: Riven's Q chain with auto-weaves lets her chunk you before your blind even fires — she sets the aggression tone at level 1.
edits.after: Riven's Broken Wings chain weaves autos between casts and chunks you before one blind can answer — she sets the tone at level 1.

edits.before: Liandry's Angueur makes your poison DoT stack threaten Riven's medium HP pool through her E shield, and mushrooms behind the wave punish any dash she burns to close distance.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment makes your poison DoT threaten Riven's medium HP pool through Valor's shield, and mushrooms behind the wave punish any dash she burns to close the distance.

edits.before: Riven's Q cooldown drops and her pattern gets crisper — if she lands W-stun while your Blinding Shot is on cooldown she can run a full three-Q knockup combo that bypasses your poison entirely.
edits.after: Broken Wings stays 13s at every rank — what sharpens here is Ki Burst at 9s and Valor at 8s. A Ki Burst landed while Blinding Dart is down buys her the whole chain into the third-cast knockback.

edits.before: Fire Blinding Shot before Riven's Q chain lands so her auto-weaves between casts miss completely
edits.after: Fire Blinding Dart before Broken Wings lands so the weaved autos miss and her Runic Blade charges rot

edits.before: Bait your Blinding Shot with a dummy Q dash, then W-stun you the moment the blind is on cooldown and your poison has not yet stacked enough to matter
edits.after: Bait your Blinding Dart with a dummy Broken Wings cast, then Ki Burst you the moment the blind is down and your poison has not stacked enough to matter

edits.after: Use Valor's shield to absorb your Toxic Shot burst so she can reach melee range and land the third Broken Wings knockback before you W away

edits.before: Riven owns level 1 through the sheer density of her Q-auto weaves — she can land two or three autos between Q casts, and your Blinding Shot only stops one window of autos, not the whole chain. Fire Q the instant she steps up to trade, not after she has already connected her first auto. At level 2 you pick up Toxic Shot and she picks up W-stun: the lane becomes a cooldown dance. Do not auto-commit poke when W is up — a well-timed W stun into your blind cooldown is half your HP before you can Move Quick away. At level 3 neither of you has a decisive edge; you can sustain the poke war as long as you keep walking backward after every Toxic Shot proc and never let her chain all three Q dashes in melee range of you.
edits.after: Riven owns level 1 through the sheer density of her Broken Wings auto-weaves — she lands two or three autos between casts, and your Blinding Dart only stops one window of autos, not the whole chain. Fire Q the instant she steps up to trade, not after she has already connected her first auto. At level 2 you pick up Toxic Shot and she picks up Ki Burst, and the lane becomes a cooldown count: her stun is 11 seconds, your blind is a flat 7. Do not poke while Ki Burst is up — a stun landed on your blind cooldown is half your HP before Move Quick helps. At level 3 neither of you has a decisive edge; keep walking backward after every Toxic Shot proc and never let all three Broken Wings casts land in melee range.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are Riven's clearest window — her Q cooldown tightens, her E shield is rank two, and she can bait your Blinding Shot with a short Q dash, then W-stun you the moment the blind expires and your W cooldown is gone. Respect this pattern: never throw Blinding Shot at a first-Q dash because she will eat the blind on her shield, reset, and run the full combo on you. Instead, hold Blinding Shot until she commits her W or until she is in auto range without her shield active. At level 6 you flip the script — mushrooms behind you and at both side-bush entrances mean she cannot safely chase a kite path, and your move-speed on a fresh W plus a shroom slow lets you dictate the range of every trade from here forward.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are Riven's clearest window — Ki Burst is down to 9 seconds, Valor to 8, and she can bait your Blinding Dart with a short Broken Wings cast, then stun you the moment the blind expires and your W is gone. Respect this pattern: never throw Blinding Dart at a first Broken Wings cast, because she eats the blind on Valor's shield, resets, and runs the whole chain on you. Hold Blinding Dart until she commits Ki Burst or stands in auto range with no shield up. At level 6 you flip the script — mushrooms behind you and at both side-bush entrances mean she cannot safely chase a kite path, and a fresh W plus a shroom slow lets you dictate every trade range from here.

edits.before: With Liandry's first item your poison makes Riven genuinely afraid to sit in a shroom-warded lane — every bush she steps through is a slow and a DoT stack that compounds with Toxic Shot, and she cannot dash through mushrooms to close the gap without burning E shield on the slow rather than your poke. You should be farming a side lane with mushroom corridors by now, not fighting in a void. The danger: if Riven gets two items (Eclipse plus Sterak's or Black Cleaver) her all-in survives your DoT and she can flash-W stun you before your Move Quick resets — avoid one-item-down fights in open space and keep every approach path sown with Noxious Traps.
edits.after: With Liandry's first item your poison makes Riven genuinely afraid to sit in a shroom-warded lane — every bush she steps through is a slow and a DoT stack that compounds with Toxic Shot, and she cannot dash through mushrooms without burning Valor on the slow rather than on your poke. You should be farming a side lane with mushroom corridors by now, not fighting in a void. The danger is Blade of the Exile: it hands her bonus range as well as damage, so the kiting distance that held all lane is suddenly short, and Wind Slash finishes anyone she chipped. Keep every approach path sown with Noxious Traps.

edits.after: Riven's Broken Wings weaves autos between casts, so Blinding Dart only negates one window, not the whole chain — she sets the damage tone before your poison stacks.

edits.after: Your Toxic Shot procs and Blinding Dart threat keep her honest, but she can bait the Q with a dash and eat it on Valor, making full trades genuinely split — neither side can force a kill.

edits.after: Both players have significant item power — Riven's Eclipse burst chunks through one Liandry's Torment, and Blade of the Exile's bonus range beats the spacing you kited with all lane, making late duels a real skill check rather than a clean Teemo advantage.
